name: Sitting Bull
role: Hunkpapa Lakota leader living at Standing Rock
bio: The Lakota leader, then living with his band at Standing Rock, appeared in the Cow Boy in 1884 when a horse thief tried to steal his horses, and in 1885 in a set of photographs of noted Indians and in a satirical piece reprinted from another paper. In March 1886 the paper reported him at his camp near Standing Rock in poor health and said his voice no longer guided the Sioux.
